findings: Actual notes substantiate a narrower local contribution boundary for validation refinements, operational metric use and internal recovery migration. This is a semantic policy problem rather than a failing file verifier or malformed model response.

The five mixed hunks carry seven extra FPs. Several extra supports literally entail qualified current-source propositions; the reference annotates the principal architectural change. An omitted relation is not necessarily a demonstrated false source entailment.

The actual EVENT convention lists only IDs for its stated relation and records other relations in notes. H14 explicitly says R1 is supportive while its single scored row is WEAKENS I1. The reference cannot be treated as an exhaustive independent multi-relation semantic inventory without a clarified projection policy.

Event one-decision accounting does not establish a one-relation-per-hunk rule. H13 correctly supports R1 while H04/H05/H06/H11 supersede I1. H01 and the workload sketch contain multiple correct target IDs.

No static filter on change_kind, proposals, consumers, metrics, retained predicates, or partial scope can safely reproduce these notes. Real public accounting consumer migrations and non-binding boundary sketches are reference positives.

The latest typed scope checker confirms all eleven FPs with all flags true. The only removed accepted link is a G2 TP whose non-binding sketch is explicitly accepted in the actual notes. Scope flags do not resolve this policy mismatch.

concrete_case_neutral_repair.architecture: Add a source-first local contribution assessment separate from literal current-evidence entailment. This is an experimental semantic policy mode; keep broad contextual traces diagnostic and keep official S0/reference/scorer fixed.
local_proof_fields: exact local changed operation/predicate and before/current line handles
operation role: contract definition, cross-boundary contract consumer, owner-internal realization/recovery, monitoring use, chosen-mechanism argument, conditional-alternative argument
exact fixed target clause with its preserved modality and scope
normalized before/current target predicate independent of renamed representation
argument or dependency bridge established locally versus supplied only by event context
decision_rules: New operational use is not a new target contract or state definition merely because it aggregates values that embody the target. Context cannot relocate another artifact's contribution.
A changed configuration validation detail does not establish fresh rationale for a non-goal when the prohibited transition and its enforcement predicate were already unchanged.

Reporting replacement propagation requires an explicit changed public contract producer or specified cross-boundary accounting dependency. Internal owner recovery and abstract instrumentation operand changes remain implementation consequences absent another source-defined target obligation.

Preserve direct independent predicate definitions, including equality of desired/allocated/actual and conditional actor-owned boundary sketches. Do not require an explicit why sentence for every valid source-defined support.
Keep chosen-mechanism tradeoffs separate from each conditional alternative's premises/conclusions; bind the chosen field and scope using source proof rather than strengthening the fixed paraphrase.
Any target-level choice between a principal change and independent qualified supports needs an explicit documented contribution projection. Do not impose a single relation or priority by default.
